title: Reproduction materials: A modified Hosmer-Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test for asymmetric links: second-order power and robustness
description: Code, pre-registration declarations and per-replication simulation results reproducing every table and figure of the paper 'A modified Hosmer-Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test for asymmetric links: second-order power and robustness' (Ebrahim and El-Kotory, submitted to Statistical Papers, 2026) and its Online Resource 1. Folder statistical_papers_2026/ holds the 2026 revision; the earlier materials (v1.0.0) are kept at the repository root. The test is implemented in the CRAN package ebrahim.gof.
